# Plane — project-management views reference

- **Source:** https://github.com/makeplane/plane
- **Inspected:** 2026-11-15. Repository landing page/README and its feature descriptions were consulted. No live Plane interface, screenshot, or source-code implementation was visually inspected.
- **License / reuse:** The repository page identifies AGPL-3.0. This file records design ideas only; do not copy source code or assets into ChargesTBA without a license review.

## Useful qualities to study

The repository describes configurable views and filters, work-item lists, cycles, modules, and analytics. These suggest useful questions for ChargesTBA: how users narrow a list, understand current scope, and move between overview and detail.

## Relevance to ChargesTBA

Use as a candidate reference for list navigation, saved/filtered data views, and information hierarchy only if a concrete ChargesTBA workflow needs those capabilities. Plane’s project-management concepts and density are not a template for a local bookkeeping product.

## Evidence and status

- **Observed:** Public repository documentation and feature descriptions.
- **Evaluated:** Potential inspiration for data-view patterns; not selected as a direct pattern source yet.
- **Not established:** Live layout, interaction behavior, responsive behavior, accessibility, exact source implementation.
- **Screenshot:** None captured.
- **Validation:** Reference only; not an approved ChargesTBA design decision.
